summary: iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, solely to announce its first monthly distribution of $457,924.72 to shareholders of record on July 2, 2026, payable July 8, 2026. The distribution derives from option premiums received June 9–30, 2026. The filing includes no acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, tender, or other special situation. It is a routine current report about a dividend declaration, not a special-situation event.
